summary: Backend smoke test for Gestor360 completed. All 13 requested checks pass: JWT login, /auth/me, unauth 401, company GET/PUT, clients CRUD, products CRUD (unique code enforced), orçamento create with auto-number and +72h valid_until, venda with stock decrement (50->47 for qty=3), convert orçamento->venda producing new sequential venda with converted_from set, PDF (application/pdf, 2.6KB), stats endpoint, register returns token, and bad Emergent session_id returns 401.
passed: POST /api/auth/login returns JWT token for seeded owner
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns user info
POST /api/products enforces unique code (dup returns 400); PUT/DELETE work
POST /api/documents orcamento: number auto-increments (1..4), valid_until=+72h, total computed on list
POST /api/documents venda with product line decrements product stock by quantity (50 -> 47)
POST /api/documents/{id}/convert creates venda copy with new sequential number and converted_from set
POST /api/auth/register creates user and returns token
action_items: Info only (not a bug): backend Document schema uses fields `lines`, `unit_price`, `discount_pct` (not `items`, `price`, `discount`). Frontend QuoteBuilder must send these exact names for lines to persist and stock to decrement.

Info only: DELETE /api/clients/{id} with empty id (e.g., after a client is stored without an id) 307-redirects to /api/clients which returns 405. This does not occur when id is properly generated (backend auto-generates via default_factory when payload omits `id`).
